name: Højlyngsstien
description_md:
Hojlyngsstien is a waymarked hiking route in DK with a distance of 67.2 km. The route includes 1233 m of ascent and 1225 m of descent.

The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. It takes about 20 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The route is part of a regional waymarked hiking network. The route passes Bornholm within 200 m.
